# RetainAI

> Customer retention CRM for Canadian service businesses. RetainAI brings customer conversations, follow-ups, appointments, invoices and retention priorities into one workspace.

## Product
- [Home](https://www.retainai.ca/): Product overview and trial questions.
- [Features](https://www.retainai.ca/features): Customer history, WhatsApp, AI-assisted drafts, appointments and follow-up.
- [Who it is for](https://www.retainai.ca/customers): Salons, home services, coaches and local service teams.
- [Retention CRM for service businesses](https://www.retainai.ca/retention-crm-for-service-businesses): What a retention CRM does and when it fits.
- [Pricing](https://www.retainai.ca/pricing): C$20 CAD monthly, one plan. Eligible new customers get 14 days. A card is required; cancel before the displayed trial end to avoid the subscription charge. Connected services can have separate fees.
- [About](https://www.retainai.ca/about): Owner Mateo Zufic and direct contact information.
- [Partners](https://www.retainai.ca/partners): Referral partnership information and terms.

## Policies
- [Privacy](https://www.retainai.ca/privacy-policy)
- [Terms](https://www.retainai.ca/terms-of-service)
- [Refunds and cancellation](https://www.retainai.ca/refund-policy)

## Accuracy
Product previews use example data, not customer endorsements. Trial eligibility, taxes and the final total are shown at checkout. No usage count, customer testimonial or external endorsement is claimed without a verified source.
